game_20260217_223017_g8:7.description: Chose to copy Wistfulness with Superior Spider-Man, but Wistfulness's ETB abilities won't trigger because the required colored mana ({G}{G} or {U}{U}) wasn't spent to cast Superior Spider-Man ({2}{U}{B}). This results in a vanilla 4/4. Oblivious Bookworm would have given a 4/4 with repeatable end-step card draw, which is crucial when nearly empty-handed against an opponent with 6 cards and two Enduring Curiosity.

game_20260219_091818_g8:46.description: Passed priority without activating Psychic Frog's discard ability. With duplicate Watery Graves and excess lands in hand, discarding at least one to put a +1/+1 counter on Psychic Frog would grow it for next turn's attack at minimal cost. The Frog draws cards on combat damage, so a bigger Frog is more likely to connect and the discarded cards also fuel its flying ability.

game_20260217_223017_g8:11.description: At 2 life facing lethal on board (4/3 Enduring Curiosity), choosing Oblivious Bookworm over Deep-Cavern Bat is a critical error. Deep-Cavern Bat would make Superior Spider-Man a 4/4 with flying and lifelink - flying blocks the Enduring Curiosity, lifelink stabilizes from 2 life, and the ETB exiles a card from opponent's 7-card hand. Oblivious Bookworm gives a ground 4/4 with a draw/discard ability that doesn't help survive.

game_20260217_223017_g8:24.description: Kimi25 Snark attempted to cast Shoot the Sheriff but failed the mana payment, resulting in no action taken during the declare attackers step. They're taking 6 damage from Formidable Speaker (2/4) and Superior Spider-Man (4/4) when they had Floodpits Drowner available at {1}{U} which could flash in, tap Superior Spider-Man (the bigger threat), and then Tishana's Tidebinder could block the 2/4 Formidable Speaker, significantly reducing combat damage. The opponent is at 2 life so preserving life total while maintaining board presence is critical.

game_20260219_091818_g6:43.description: Cast Young Wolf before playing a land, missing the opportunity to play Wooded Foothills first, fetch a land, and have 2 mana available to cast Badgermole Cub instead. Badgermole Cub would accelerate toward casting Yawgmoth (the key combo piece) by creating extra mana via earthbend, which is critical with two 4/4 Territorial Kavus threatening lethal. Even if Young Wolf was the intended play, playing the land first preserves more options.

game_20260226_003306_g4:3.description: Bottomed Hollow One instead of Marauding Mako, giving up the explosive Turn 1 line of Burning Inquiry into free Hollow One (4/4). With Burning Inquiry causing 3 discards, Hollow One costs 0 mana. Even accounting for the ~43% chance Hollow One gets randomly discarded by Burning Inquiry, the expected value of keeping it is much higher than keeping Marauding Mako (a 1/1 for R). Additionally, Orcish Bowmasters punishes the opponent's 3 draws from Burning Inquiry.

game_20260226_003306_g5:4.description: In Legacy, it's generally better to play fetchlands before dual lands. Playing Bloodstained Mire and fetching Badlands would thin the deck while keeping the other Mire for later, preserving options. Playing Badlands first wastes a chance to thin the deck (since they'd play Mires on subsequent turns fetching from a library that still has Badlands in it - though actually Badlands was the only copy).

game_20260217_223017_g8:3.description: Casting Enduring Curiosity in their own postcombat main phase when it has flash. This taps out all 4 lands, leaving no mana to interact on the opponent's turn. The opponent has Oblivious Bookworm which will trigger at end step for card advantage.

game_20260226_003306_g4:14.description: Playing Boseiju, Who Endures as a land wastes its Channel ability (instant-speed removal for artifacts/enchantments/nonbasic lands) and provides less mana acceleration than Eldrazi Temple for the Eldrazi-heavy game plan. Both lands enable casting Glaring Fleshraker this turn, but Eldrazi Temple's extra colorless mana for Eldrazi spells would enable a larger Kozilek's Command on future turns.

game_20260226_003306_g4:9.description: Playing Blood Crypt as the first land instead of Bloodstained Mire is slightly suboptimal. Bloodstained Mire preserves flexibility - it can be cracked at instant speed to fetch whichever basic land type is needed, and fetching a basic costs only 1 life vs 2 life for Blood Crypt untapped. Playing the fetch land first is standard sequencing since it provides maximum optionality throughout the turn.
